title: AssemblyRequest
description: Represents a single document-assembly request. request_id is the caller-supplied idempotency key. (scope plan §6.3, AD-06, AD-13)

request_id.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key. Unique per workspace.

workspace_id.description: Immutable workspace identifier. Required on every workspace-owned record (AD-13).

options.description: Per-request option key-value pairs. Keys and values are strings.

placeholder_values.description: Placeholder substitution values. Keys must match ^[A-Z0-9_]+$ (scope plan §4.2 Placeholder entity).

requested_by.description: Identity (email or member ID) of the person who submitted the request.

raw_input_ref.description: Optional reference to the original free-text ask. Never the content itself in the ledger (SB-06).
